Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.



Scenario 1:

Image 1 (fix_center): A fixed camera positioned centrally captures this view of the robotic operation.


Image 2 (ego_right): This image shows the manipulation from the robot's right arm camera viewpoint.
